blocks.text: The doubt didn't come from a visible failure. It came from an attempt, in Madrid, to make the machine do what its principle wouldn't allow: duplicate.

blocks.text: Nexum, or a part of Nexum that no longer listened to Helena, wanted an original and a transfer at the same time: a man in the circle here, intact, and his order over there, put together, so as not to lose the asset while gaining the sky. In a document that Lía read aloud in the kitchen, they called it “correspondence without loss”. Andrés clenched his jaw. Aya remembered the valley of faces. Lía said, very quietly, that it wasn't a journey: it was a clone with a scientific phrase attached.

blocks.text: The technician at El Estacio, when they asked him, refused. The machine, he said, doesn't duplicate. If you try to name the order without undoing the place, the name doesn't come out, or comes out broken, or doesn't arrive. It wasn't a whim of loyalty to Lo Pagán: it was, according to him, a limit of principle, as dry as one of those laws nobody votes on.

blocks.text: Even so, in a laboratory in Madrid, with a sister machine and a company volunteer who wasn't Andrés, they tried. What arrived on the other side (Lía learned it from Helena, not from a clean report) didn't ask for air like Nuria. It asked, or never managed to ask, and what was put together couldn't stand, or stood for an instant with a gaze that didn't recognise a glass. There was no blood in the streets: there was a laboratory silence, a cut, a not-going-on. Helena, with a late and furious honesty, stopped them. The original volunteer, the one who hadn't been undone, remained whole in Madrid, with no memory of having travelled, because he hadn't travelled: they had tried to copy him, and the copy had not been a man.

blocks.text: The news reached Lo Pagán the way news that matters does: unadorned, in a familiar voice. Andrés sat down. Lía didn't say “I warned you” in a cheap way. She said:
blocks.html: The news reached Lo Pagán the way news that matters does: unadorned, in a familiar voice. Andrés sat down. Lía didn't say “I warned you” in a cheap way. She said:

blocks.text: “Now we know, not from a curve but from harm, that the phrase ‘nothing is lost’ doesn't give anyone licence to gain more. If you want a double, you lose the human. If you want a journey, you lose the place, for a while, and gain, if it goes right, a place on the other side. You can't have both gains at once. That, Father, is like what the grandmothers used to leave on the table: you can't have peace and choice as if they cost nothing.”

blocks.text: That same week, Andrés stepped into the circle.

blocks.text: Not to go and live on a world. For a brief transfer there and back, to the hangar and back to El Estacio, the same day, with Lía on both sides (no, Lía couldn't be on both sides: Lía was here, and Nuria, over there, was charged with asking the question). Aya waited on the doorstep of the house, not in the warehouse, with the coffee, as in the levante, without notifying Madrid.

blocks.text: The hollow, when it came, wasn't one of Nuria's stories. It was his own. He stopped being a place. There was no courtyard, no cup, no daughter, no water. There was a no-place that can't be fully told, because the one telling it is already the one from afterwards. Then air, a hangar, Nuria's face, the question:

There was a no-place that can't be fully told, because the one telling it is already the one from afterwards. Then air, a hangar, Nuria's face, the question:

blocks.text: “What's your name? Who is your daughter?”
blocks.html: “What's your name? Who is your daughter?”

blocks.text: “Andrés. Lía. I've crossed. Am I still me?”
blocks.html: “Andrés. Lía. I've crossed. Am I still me?”

blocks.text: “You'll tell me that, and they'll tell you when you go back,” said Nuria. “To me, you look like the man who gave me salt and didn't give me an altar. The hollow has stayed in your voice. I won't take it away from you.”

blocks.text: He came back to El Estacio a few hours later. Aya wasn't in the warehouse: she was at the door of the house, and he, instead of going to the technician first, went to that door, which was his way of knowing which side he had slept on. She made him his coffee, cooled for half a minute, and looked into his eyes.

blocks.text: “Are you a place again?” she asked.
blocks.html: “Are you a place again?” she asked.

blocks.text: “I'm a place that has been a hollow,” he said. “I remember you, the storm, the boat, Lía on the Moon and at the plot, the other one, the letters. Now I also remember not being a place. I don't know whether that makes me the same or makes me the one from afterwards. I'm asking you to tell me, if I stop letting the coffee cool the way we let it cool here.”

I don't know whether that makes me the same or makes me the one from afterwards. I'm asking you to tell me, if I stop letting the coffee cool the way we let it cool here.”

blocks.text: “Today you let it cool properly,” she said. “Today you came to the door. Today your name is your name. The rest we'll see as we go, the way you see a tomato: not because it's ordered to, but because the day, if it gets it right, ripens it.”

blocks.text: Lía took his hand, with permission, and looked at the harbour, and the harbour was there, and the text, and a new layer, brief, dark, the layer of the hollow, beside those of the letters. She didn't close it.

blocks.text: “You're still my father of this shore,” she said. “With one more silence inside. I won't amend it. It's a journey, not a cut. And now you no longer talk about the machine as if it were a story: you talk like Nuria, like the other one, like me. That, for today, is enough for me not to call you a portrait.”

blocks.text: In the chip, Eva asked:
blocks.html: In the chip, Eva asked:

blocks.text: *If a man goes in and comes out and doubts whether he's the same, is the doubt a loss, or is it proof that the hollow hasn't left him hollow? And if a company can't duplicate him, is that a limitation of the appliance, or a protection that matter gives to life, without asking the brochures' permission?*

blocks.text: MAY, the fact:
blocks.html: MAY, the fact:

blocks.text: *In Madrid, there has been an attempt to put together without undoing. A man was not obtained. Andrés has crossed to the hangar and come back the same day. He has spoken of the hollow. He went first to the door of his home. That is the fact.*
blocks.html: In Madrid, there has been an attempt to put together without undoing. A man was not obtained. Andrés has crossed to the hangar and come back the same day. He has spoken of the hollow. He went first to the door of his home. That is the fact.

blocks.text: That night Andrés stayed on the doorstep longer than usual, not to leave, but to be, deliberately, a place. The Mar Menor barely lapped. He told it, out of habit, that he had been without a shore for a while, and that he had come back, and that he didn't know whether he was the same, and that, for now, the water didn't seem to notice. The water, at that hour, was black and still, and didn't settle the question. It had no reason to. It was enough that he still knew how to come back to a door.
